profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Versapay
profile.summary:
Software professional with 12+ years of development experience.

My differentiator is my proficiency in both the technical and human aspects of software development. I hold Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science and Business Management and have led development teams at both start-ups as well as enterprises / government organizations. These experiences have equipped me with a well-rounded skill set that combines technological expertise with business acumen and excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Outgoing and detail-oriented, I have solved complex problems and shipped production code using the latest front-end (React, React Native) and back-end (Python, Docker, Rails, Postgres) technologies.

I have a combined 15+ years of remote work experience and a proven track record of providing people leadership and technical mentorship / guidance to my team and organization.

- Helped to identify and upgrade vulnerable web application installs to prevent hacks and protect customer data.

- Worked with a senior developer to develop a web-based PHP to-do app for learning and internal use.

positions.title: Remote Online Student Community Manager
positions.description:
- Improved the online educational experience of over 3,000 customers by crafting informative mini-sites using HTML and CSS.

- Pioneered relationship building initiatives and online academic groups which dramatically improved customer participation and retention as demonstrated through direct feedback and website traffic metrics.

positions.title: Remote Academic & Life Coach
positions.description:
- As an Academic & Life Coach, assisted over 200 students in defining, equipping for, and living their calling by maintaining bi-weekly coaching calls and unlimited email support with up to 80 students at a time while working remotely.

- Utilized organizational and time-management skills to provide an exceptional customer experience which resulted in multiple promotions as well as high customer satisfaction as measured by customer surveys.

positions.title: Remote Team Manager
positions.description:
- Remotely managed a team of 4-6 peer coaches and was responsible for their success and the success of their students.

- Identified a key performance bottleneck affecting not only my team but the entire company, and utilized HTML, CSS, and programming skills to craft and deploy a solution which resulted in massive time savings and was eventually assimilated into the company's core technology suite.

positions.title: Remote Product Development Researcher
positions.description:
- As part of an internal team, helped develop, refine, and test educational products focused on helping students improve their study skills.

- Took initiative in helping the CollegePlus Development department leverage technology for smoother workflow and helped craft new inter-departmental procedures and best practices for product development. This resulted in 100% on-time submission of deliverables under my direct supervision.

positions.title: Remote Database Research Consultant
positions.description:
- Researched end-user requirements for an enterprise information system and consolidated feedback into mock-ups and user stories for use by the IT department which resulted in a final software solution that had a high satisfaction level due to its meeting end-user requirements.

- Helped IT department get a behind-schedule project back on track by streamlining data collection and presenting it in a way that was accessible to all application stakeholders.

projects.title: Computer Science Bachelor's Capstone Project
projects.description:
Coodle450 is a compiler written in Java for the fictional programming language Oodle. It can compile Oodle programs with the following features:

Expressions:
- Instance variable declarations (types int and boolean only) without initializer expressions
- Expressions: Literals, identifiers, parenthesized expressions, arithmetic and boolean expressions
- Assignment statements

Control structures:
- If-Then-Else statements
- Loop While statements

Methods:
- Method declarations with arguments and an optional return type
- Call expressions (assign the return value from a method to a variable)
- Method calls (stand-alone method calls with no return value assignment)

Other features:
- Recursion (uses stack-based activation records)
- Input of integer data using the Oodle standard library function x := in.readint( )
- Output of integer data using the Oodle standard library function out.writeint(x)

More information is available in the README on GitHub at the link above.
